english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for using something or someone to gain an advantage, whether the context is neutral or unfair.

exampleSentences.english: We can exploit this opportunity to improve community services.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我哋可以利用呢個機會改善社區服務。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 lei6 jung6 ni1 go3 gei1 wui6 goi2 sin6 se5 keoi1 fuk6 mou6

english.note: Use 利用 when “tap into” means making use of or exploiting a resource, ability, or market.

exampleSentences.english: We need to tap into online platforms to enter overseas markets.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我哋要利用網上平台打入海外市場。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 lei6 jung6 mong5 soeng6 ping4 toi1 daa2 jap6 hoi2 ngoi6 si5 coeng4
